column3: Painterly digital background painting for a dark nautical fantasy roguelike deckbuilder, rich oil-paint texture, deep teal and sea-green palette with cold turquoise glows and warm lantern-gold light, matching a set of moody painted cave scenes. Wide 3:2 landscape, no people, no creatures, no text, no letters, no frame. The scene: a vast cave chamber full of air, deep below a lighthouse. Old stone stairs cut by long-gone keepers descend along the left wall to a ledge of wet flagstones in the foreground. Beyond the ledge the chamber floor is still, black water held unnaturally high, with faint turquoise glows deep under its surface. There is no sunlight: the only warm light is a lantern glow spilling from the lower left onto the stone, and cold turquoise glimmers on the water and on pale growths on the walls. Old iron mooring rings in the stone and a rotted pier post. Keep the lower third calm and dark, and keep the centre and right open, because creatures and the interface are drawn over it.

column3: Painterly digital character illustration for a dark nautical fantasy roguelike deckbuilder: rich oil-paint texture, deep teal and sea-green shadows, warm lantern-gold and brass highlights, cold turquoise brinelight rim light. A single full-body character, standing, three-quarter view facing right, filling about 90% of the height of a 2:3 portrait canvas, on a fully transparent background (alpha): no backdrop, no ground, no ground shadow, no frame, no text. It is shown about 220 px tall in a fight, on the left of the screen facing sea creatures on the right, and larger on an equipment screen, so the outfit must read clearly at small size. The character: Wren, a young woman lighthouse keeper with an oval face, dark brown wavy hair loosely tied back with a few strands blowing, a determined look. She stands in open night air on the shore, NOT underwater. She wears a long ochre-yellow oilskin coat, open and belted, over a dark blue-green knitted jumper and a dark grey-green skirt, a faded red wool scarf blowing out behind her, and heavy laced leather boots. A worn leather satchel hangs at her hip. In her right hand (on the left of the picture) she holds a long iron harpoon upright with a rope coiled around its shaft; her left hand (on the right of the picture) holds a lit brass storm lantern raised high, glowing warm gold. Over her oilskin coat she wears an old keeper's cork life vest: chunky weathered tan cork blocks sewn into faded canvas, fastened with two leather straps and brass buckles across her chest. The vest is clearly visible.
